page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Compute capabilities include instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA, backed by 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache.

The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB per vCPU). It does not include integrated GPUs or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent operational needs. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Performance benchmarks place the instance primarily within the lower historical tiers. CPU execution achieves a PassMark CPU score of 3,635.21 and a multi-core stress-ng rating of 2,929.74, while Geekbench tests record 919.0 in single-core and 2,000.0 in multi-core metrics. Memory throughput registers at 21.24 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 18.69 GB/sec for writes, resulting in a PassMark memory score of 1,360.14. Real-world workload tests demonstrate a static web serving throughput of 2.44 GB/sec, Redis SET performance of 2.86 million operations per second, and small LLM text generation at 61.65 tokens per second.

Due to its moderate compute output and balanced memory allocation, the ecs.sn2.large delivers functional cost efficiency for low-intensity, steady-state applications that do not demand high instruction throughput. It is technically appropriate for entry-level microservices, small internal web serving, testing environments, background utility processes, and light database or cache duties.
